drafts_today.topic: Black Friday deal question (rides 'Bestie, what's your Black Friday skincare deal?' 46,729 views)
drafts_today.text:
Bestie, what's your Black Friday skincare deal?

Mine: RIMAN's holiday bundles. Up to 57% in free value, and the gift bag and tissue come with them.

They end Friday at 11:59 PM PT.

Who are you shopping for first: you, your mom, or your sister?
drafts_today.picture_tip: One bundle box (or your products) beside the free gift bag and tissue on your kitchen table, morning window light. Plain photo, no text.
drafts_today.video_tip: 6-8s: your hand slides the gift bag into frame, tucks tissue in, drops a product in. On-screen text: 'Ends Fri 11:59 PM PT'.

drafts_today.topic: Less makeup after 50: 3-step holiday face (rides 'sell makeup to women over 50' 808 views / 12 bookmarks)
drafts_today.text:
Holiday makeup after 50 doesn't mean more makeup.

My 3 steps, after my skincare has fully settled:
1. Sheer Glow BB, dotted on and blended with fingertips
2. Butter Lip Liner, then Butter Lip Tint, patted to set
3. Set & Stay spray to finish

Save this for party season.
drafts_today.picture_tip: Flat lay on your bathroom counter: Sheer Glow BB, Butter Lip Liner, Butter Lip Tint, Set & Stay in a row, numbered 1-2-3 with small sticky notes.
drafts_today.video_tip: 12-15s: dot BB on forehead, cheeks, nose, chin; blend with fingertips; line lips from the centre out; pat the tint; 2 sprays of Set & Stay. On-screen text: 'Holiday face after 50: 3 steps'.

drafts_today.topic: Shop small weekend at Trail Bay Centre (Small Business Saturday Nov 28; CFIB 'shop local' push)
drafts_today.text:
Shop small this weekend, Sunshine Coast.

Find me at Trail Bay Centre in Sechelt:
Fri Nov 27, 11 to 4 (last day of RIMAN's holiday bundles)
Sun Nov 29

Try the products on your own hands, and guess the candies in the tub to win a Multi Stick Balm, a facial, or both.
drafts_today.picture_tip: Your Trail Bay poster held up next to the candy tub on your table, with the logo in view.
drafts_today.video_tip: 8-10s: shake the candy tub, set it on the table, pan to the products. On-screen text: 'Guess the candies. Trail Bay, Fri + Sun'.
